Sonesta Bee Cave Austin Hill Country puts the Texas Hill Country at your doorstep, with Lake Travis, nearby wineries and Hill Country Galleria all close by. Downtown Austin is just 20 minutes away when you’re ready for live music, dining or a night in the city.
At the hotel, spend the afternoon by the outdoor pool, then head to Meridian 98 for sunset cocktails, local favorites and sweeping views. With genuine Texas hospitality and an easy balance of Hill Country charm and Austin energy, your stay feels distinctly Texas from start to finish.
At Sonesta Hotels & Resorts, we’re so happy you’re here.
Read More +
Dining in Austin
Start your day at The Hive, our cozy onsite coffee shop, then wind down at our rooftop restaurant, Meridian 98.
Discover Our Dining

Select Room and Guest Count 1 Room, 1 Guest Select Rate Type Rates Find Hotel Location ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ Edit Sonesta Hotels Resorts - Tx - Bee Cave - Sonesta Bee Cave Austin - Dining Meridian 98 Reserve a Table Experience Our Bee Cave Restaurant Discover Our Food From shareable starters to satisfying entrées and something sweet to finish, the menu at Meridian 98 is designed for easy evenings and good company. Executive Chef Patrick Newman brings together seasonal ingredients, Texas influences and fresh flavors that pair naturally with a cocktail and a Hill Country sunset. Explore Our Menus Find Us in Bee Cave Located on the 6th floor of the Sonesta Bee Cave Austin Hill Country hotel, Meridian 98 is a cozy retreat for locals, explorers, and business travelers alike. Get Directions Discover Our Hotel At Sonesta Bee Cave Austin Hill Country, you can spend the afternoon by the outdoor pool, start the morning at The Hive and end the day with sunset cocktails at Meridian 98. Explore the Hotel Plan Your Visit Working Hours Sunday – Thursday: 4:00PM – 10:00PM Friday – Saturday: 4:00PM – 11:00PM Reserve a Table Meet the Chef Executive Chef Patrick Newman For Executive Chef Patrick Newman, food has always been personal. Raised in Louisiana and inspired by both of his grandmothers, Chef Newman brings years of Four-Diamond culinary experience to Meridian 98. His approach pairs seasonal ingredients with approachable flavors and a sense of place, creating food that feels right at home alongside a cocktail, good company and a Texas sunset. Explore Chef Newman’s Creations Jazz Down Thursdays Live Jazz at Meridian 98 Thursday evenings sound a little better from the rooftop. Join us for Jazz Down Thursdays, featuring live music from Honeybee Jazz,, cocktails, dinner and sweeping views as the sun goes down. Every Thursday from 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Admission is complimentary. Come early for happy hour, find your seat and settle in for an evening of live jazz above Bee Cave. Learn more about Honeybee Jazz Football Watch Parties Coffee to Cocktails Package – Over $75 in Added Value Catch the game at Meridian 98 with food, drinks and plenty of reasons to stay through the final whistle. We’ll show select Thursday and Sunday football games in the bar and back lounge, with game-day food and drink specials including wings, nachos and beer buckets. Game times and matchups vary each week. Check This Week’s Games & Specials SPECIAL OFFER Coffee to Cocktails Package – Over $75 in Added Value Start your morning with handcrafted coffee at The Hive and end your day with sunset sips at Meridian 98. This thoughtfully curated package includes coffee, cocktails or mocktails, a waived destination fee, and late checkout, perfect for a relaxed Hill Country escape. Learn more & book with promo code SIP Make the rooftop yours. Private Events at Meridian 98 From rehearsal dinners and welcome receptions to milestone celebrations, corporate gatherings and cocktail hours, Meridian 98 offers a memorable Bee Cave setting with sweeping views, indoor and outdoor space and customized food and beverage options.
